batting.name: RR Pant
batting.dismissal: c J Suchith b S Kaul

batting.name: SO Hetmyer
batting.dismissal: c KS Williamson b S Kaul

batting.name: JM Bairstow
batting.dismissal: c S Dhawan b Avesh Khan

batting.name: Virat Singh
batting.dismissal: c MP Stoinis b Avesh Khan

batting.name: KM Jadhav
batting.dismissal: st RR Pant b A Mishra

balls.text: offcutter outside off, beats Smith's outside edge. But he and Stoinis cross over for a bye
slower ball, on a back of a length on middle. Smith brings his bottom wrist into play and shovel-pulls it in the air, clearing deep square leg
carved over short third man for four. Smith hoicks to the leg side, but the edge flies over the infielder for four
shortish and outside off, chopped only as far as point
back of a length and outside off, Khaleel cuts his pace again, stabbed out to extra-cover
shortish and outside off, 119ks slower ball, lashed away off the back foot to deep point
Williamson runs in from long-off and takes this skier. Cool as...Pitched up and outside off, in the slot, but the lack of pace does Hetmyer in. He slices it to Williamson and falls for 1 off 2 balls
seems like a legcutter, 117ks, slapped away past the right of sweeper cover
wide yorker, sliced away to the right of Vijay at sweeper
middle-stump yorker, Smith backs away and jams it just wide of short third man

Holes out to deep midwicket. Simple catch for Suchith in the outfield. Kaul bangs a cutter into the pitch, takes it away from Pant's swinging arc. He fetches it from outside off and drags it to Suchith. It's the smaller side of the ground, but Pant can't clear it this time
wide yorker, veering away from Pant. He can't put bat on ball
yorker on middle, inside-edged away....Williamson makes a sprawling save at short fine leg
Trick shot from Rishabh Pant. He makes it look so very easy. Full and outside off, he shuffles away and reverse-scoops it in the air to the right of short third man
back of a length and outside off, punched firmly to sweeper cover off the back foot
length ball angling away outside off, Smith swings to the leg side once again and nicks it between short third man and keeper. Replays suggest this was an offcutter as well
offcutter, Khaleel digs it into the pitch and shifts his line wide of off. Smith has a roundhouse swipe at it...and misses
slower bouncer on middle, keeps climbing at Pant and messes with his pull. Flapped in the air wide of short fine leg
good finish to the over from Vijay - just four of it. Back of a length and into the pitch, angling into Smith who had shifted outside leg. The batter misses the pull and wears it on his thigh pad
full and wide of off, 118ks, Vijay asks Pant to reach out for the ball. So the batter loses his shape and carves it to the right of sweeper. Suchith is a fine fielder and he keeps it to one
wide yorker from Vijay, good execution from the allrounder, sneaks under the swinging bat of Pant
full on middle and leg, 121ks, chipped to deep midwicket after shifting across off stump
just short of the blockhole, decent start to the over from Vijay, jammed to the covers
Dropped again, this time by Kaul at short third man. This is a sitter. Smith gives himself some room. Cutter into the pitch. Sliced in the air. Pops in and out of Kaul's hands
shorter on middle and leg, punched through midwicket off the back foot
another googly, dinked into the leg side
drags a googly down the leg side, beats Pant, and Bairstow as well. Maybe Pant got some ball on ball

Missed by Khaleel running in from short fine leg. He can't even touch it. He lunges at the ball, the ball bounces in front of him, and defeats him. Khaleel didn't attack the ball enough. Pant gets away with a spliced slog-sweep
pushed through on off, may have been a wrong'un, Smith hauls a slog-sweep to wide long-on
short and sliding into middle, Smith slinks around his crease, and chops it only as far as point
another cutter into the sluggish Chepauk pitch. Smith camps back, delays his whip, and quietly knocks it through midwicket
on a length and wide of off, another cutter, Pant powers it down to long-off
short, wide, flayed away to the right of Vijay at sweeper again. Another hard-run double, this needed a dive from Pant
down the track to meet a short, wide ball. Slaps it wide of Vijay at sweeper and picks up a hard-run two
Hoicked away straight of wide long-on. Slower cutter from Kaul, into the pitch, and the line is wide of off. Pant sizes it up and manufactures his own power. Hits the ad board on the full. It's a six
starts off with a slower cutter, Pant looks to angle it down to third man, but is beaten
round-arm slider into the pads, turned straight to Khaleel at short fine leg
Great hands from Pant! He brings out the reverse-sweep, fetches it from leg stump or rather outside leg. He picks it off wide of point
another short ball on off stump, hoicked away to deep midwicket
shorter googly, played back to the left of Rashid
tossed up on middle, full, Smith rocks into a slog-sweep. Abhishek dives to his right to stop the ball at deep midwicket
back-of-a-length and fizzing into middle, not sure if it was a slider or googly. Played back
slower legbreak from Vijay, he takes it away from Smith's reach. Plinked into the covers
Smith reverse-swats the free-hit between backward point and short third man. Vijay aims for the yorker, comes out as a low full-toss, which is smartly put away in the gap

What was that? Moon ball from Vijay. He loses his grip and sends out a head-high full-toss that dips late. Pant loses his shape and swipes it to the leg side. No-ball called. Warner seemingly gesticulates to the umpire Vijay had lost control of the ball
another slower ball, back of a length on off, good defensive bowling, hauled to deep midwicket
shortish and outside off, Pant winds up for a big hit and ends up  toe-ending the ball to short third man
another slower ball, wobbling into Pant, played back to the left of Vijay
hip-high short ball outside off, 116ks, pulled to deep midwicket off the back foot
forced to short midwicket with the spin
back of a length and outside off, punched past the left of Suchith to wide long-off
on a length and spinning into middle and leg, worked through square leg

Bairstow misses a stumping chance. But Shaw is run-out in the end at Suchith's end. The bowler has collected the ball cleanly to take the bails off. The TV umpire confirms that Shaw is short of his crease. Pant runs past a slider, the ball pops out of Baistow's gloves. Khaheel swoops down on the ball from short fine leg and flings a throw to Suchith to capitalise on a mix-up. There wasn't a run there. Shaw pays the price for his misjudgement. That Pant was ball-watching didn't help his cause either
pushed through on off, doesn't turn, Shaw drops to one knee and hauls a slog-sweep to Abhishek on the bounce at deep midwicket
sliding into middle, flat, nice defensive bowling from Suchith. Played back to him
another wrong'un, which is cautiously negotiated off the back foot
short legbreak outside off, cut firmly off the back foot to sweeper cover
length-ball legbreak, on middle and leg, clipped to deep midwicket
fast wrong'un from Rashid, rushes the batter and pings the pad after starting outside leg

Dhawan steps out and misses the line. Rashid hikes his pace to 96ks, slips in the slider, well away from the reach of Dhawan's big swipe. Darts past the pad to hit top of leg stump. Rashid, as he often does, gives SRH a much-needed breakthrough
shortish and spinning in from outside off, this wrong'un is slapped away to sweeper cover
looped up, angling into middle, Shaw presses forward, pats it to the right of the bowler and raises a 35-ball half-century
back of a length and on the leg stump, pulled away through the leg side off the back foot
Dhawan comes down the track, Suchith is wary of it and digs it shorter and closer to off. Chopped hard into the pitch
down the track and pushed to wide long-on. Shaw aims for the double, but has to wait for his half-century
tossed up on the pads, clipped away through midwicket
slower through the air, angling away around off, quietly defended to cover
chopped from the top of off stump to short third man
down the track and clattered over extra-cover. Shaw collapses his back knee, moves outside leg, and then dashes out to hit Rashid inside-out
dragged down outside off, the ball isn't coming onto the bat this time. Dragged away to deep midwicket
shorter and spinning away outside off, googly to the left-hander this time, chopped to Vijay's right at sweeper cover
wrong'un, flat and spinning back into middle, Shaw picks the variation and knocks it wide of midwicket with the spin
lobs an off-stump full-toss, which is swatted away between wide long-on and deep midwicket
dropped short and wide of off, Dhawan leans back and carves a cut to sweeper cover
back of a length on off, cramps Dhawan for room. Chopped beside his feet
Suchith drops it short now, Dhawan swivels back and pulls it over a leaping Warner at square leg
Dhawan dashes out of the crease, Suchith spots it. So, he shortens his length and shifts his lines wider of off. Drilled straight of wide long-off
low full-toss on off stump, hauled away to wide long-on
pushed through on the stumps, swept flat and hard to long leg
another little cutter from Vijay, fullish and outside off, nowhere near short enough for the pull. Dips under Shaw's pull

sliced in the air, but eludes the outstretched hand of Warner, I think, at backward point. Full and wide of off, Dhawan reaches out for the ball and carves it in the air. Rashid slides in the outfield and pulls the ball into play
length ball on middle, Shaw checks his drive and pushes the ball down to long-on
slower offcutter, fullish and on middle and leg, no pace on the ball. Shaw can't manufacture his own pace. Bunted to short midwicket
slower ball wobbling down the leg side, wide
floated into middle, not short enough for the pull and comes very slow off the pitch. Inside-edged onto the pad
back of a length and holds its line outside off, doesn't bounce as much as Shaw expected it to. The ball shoots under his pull
good length and angling into middle, Dhawan bunts it to midwicket, searches for a single, but is rightly sent back by Shaw
arm ball from Suchith, keeps coming in at Dhawan from left-arm over. He just about keeps it out via an inside edge
drifting into the hips on a short of a length, short-armed away to square leg off the back foot
wicket-to-wicket stuff, no turn, played back to Suchith
dragged short on middle, pulled off the back foot to Vijay at deep midwicket
starts off with an arm ball that snakes on outside off, Shaw chucks his hands at the ball and almost plays on
slower offcutter, glided fine of short third man for one
lifter outside off, Shaw sticks his bat up, gets on top of it, and ramps it over short third man for four
another hip-high short delivery outside off, Dhawan rocks into a pull and hauls the ball away to deep midwicket
back of a length and angling down the leg side, tickled away fine of long leg
slower ball, short, wide, Dhawan leans back and cuts it to Vijay manning the sweeper fence on the off side
hard-length cutter outside off, Shaw hauls it away through square leg off the inner half
banged in shorter and slanting into the body of Shaw. He rides the bounce and turns a single to the right of midwicket
slower offcutter on middle and leg, Dhawan camps back and dinks it through square leg
Dhawan gets behind this short ball outside off and fends it to point with an open face
pitched up and wide of off, slashed in the air to Vijay at deep point
punched through the line to the right of sweeper cover
back of a length and slanting into middle and leg, nurdled away through square leg

pumped over extra-cover. Shaw continues to deal in boundaries. Slightly overpitched and outside off, Shaw stays leg-side of the ball, brings his bat down, and hoists it over the infield with utmost authority
length-ball cutter outside off, into the pitch, grips and bounces past the outside edge. Shaw aims to drive on the up...and misses
pitched up and outside off, smeared straight to mid-off
Shaw rides the bounce of this shortish ball outside off and plays it to point

Dropped by Jadhav at short midwicket. He lets it burst through his hands in the infield. Hip-high on-pace short ball wide of off. Dhawan drags a pull in the air and gets away. It was hit hard, but that should've been taken
on a length and outside off, slower ball, guided to point
flighted around off stump, Shaw gets underneath the length this time. He holds his shape, checks his drive, and chips it to the left of the bowler and right of mid-off
full again, slower on middle, Shaw can't get underneath the length. He loads up and slices it towards mid-on
flat and quick, dipping into the pads, Shaw stretches out, drops down to one knee and slog-sweeps over square leg
down the track and whisked away to mid-on for a sharp single
shorter and skidding in just outside off, Dhawan gives himself more room and cuts it firmly between cover-point and backward point
drifting down the leg side for a wide
flat and quick, slides on outside off, Dhawan goes on the back foot and slashes to extra-cover
full and hung up wide of off, Shaw's front foot is rooted to the crease. He searches for the ball with his hands and ekes out an inner edge to the leg side
similar line and length, slanting away from Shaw, tip and run to point
Khaleel hits a hard length and gets it to swerve away outside off, Shaw hops and fends it off to point
make that a hat-trick of fours. Punchily driven through the covers. Overpitched and outside off, crunnnnnnched through the line
back-to-back fours for Shaw to start with. Inswinger, shortish, finishes on the hips, picked off through backward square leg. Rashid Khan runs around, slides, and parries the ball away into the fence
cracked hard through the covers. Khaleel drags it short and outside off, slants away further, cut powerfully between extra-cover and point
back of a length and skidding in to cramp Suchith for length and room. Suchith and Williamson sneak a leg bye and set up a Super Over - the first of this season
Rabada digs it on a heavy length and gets it to swerve back in. Williamson chucks his hands at the ball and nicks it on the bounce to Pant
back of a length and ducks in from outside off to beat Suchith. Another bye
mowed over midwicket for a towering six! Slower ball into the pitch, short and outside off, Suchith manufactures his own pace and smites it over the leg side for a massive six
Williamson backs away outside off, looks to thrash it through the covers, but Rabada digs a slower cutter into the pitch and beats the batter. Beats Pant too. The cross over for a bye
Rabada misses the yorker outside off, Williamson jumps across off, goes so very low, and scoops it in the air fine of short fine leg. Supreme skill
Williamson shuffles across off, Rabada sprays it down the leg side. Wide
short of a length and on middle, Suchith lines it up and whacks a pull over backward square leg for another four
back of a length and slanting away in the channel, Suchith aims third man but is beaten on the outside edge
short and on the hips, Suchith glances it away fine of long leg for a much-needed four
Vijay plays on! Slower ball dug into the pitch outside off. Vijay has a roundhouse swipe to the leg side and can only drag it back onto his own stumps
pitched up and just outside off, whipped wide of deep midwicket for a double. SRH need the boundaries now. Doubles won't do
just short of the blockhole and outside off, shovelled away to deep midwicket. Just a single
slower ball attempted by Avesh but he pushes it past the tramline. Off-side wide
back of a length, flat on middle, whipped between deep midwicket and wide long-on. Vijay gets the double and puts Williamson back on strike
slower legbreak from Mishra, Williamson checks his cut and stabs through extra-cover for just one
pushed through on middle and leg, Williamson miscues a slog-sweep, drags it straighter to wide long-on. Vijay tears back for the second
slider from Mishra, keeps coming back at Vijay, chopped hastily to short third man. He gets Williamson back on strike
reverse-swept from the stumps to short third man
blameless back-of-a-length legbreak wide of off. Williamson collapses his back knee and drills it wide of long-off
down the track and patted to extra-cover as Williamson retains the strike
sliding on outside off, late-cut to short third man
shorter and fired into middle, whipped between deep midwicket and wide long-on for a double
good length, drifting into middle and bouncing to take the leading edge and pop up square on the off side

This looks adjacent, too, as Axar wins another lbw appeal from umpire Ananthapadmanabhan. Slider from Axar, fired on middle, Rashid can't connect with the reverse-sweep and is trapped bang in front of middle

Abhishek has been given out lbw, he chats with Williamson and calls for a review. Full from Axar, spinning into Abhishek to beat the inner edge and ping the front pad on the knee-roll in line with middle. Ultra Edge confirms that there's no bat involved here. The tracker returns three reads and umpire Ananthapadmanabhan's on-field out decision has been vindicated
hauled in the air between deep midwicket and wide long-on. Williamson brings up a half-century on a tough pitch. His captain Warner applauds from the dug-out
mighty full and outside off, jammed out to long-off
on a length and angling into off, plinked to deep midwicket off the inner half
on a length and angling across off, Abhishek opens the face and dabs it square through the off side
off-side wide
Avesh hammers it on a hard length and outside off, Abhishek closes the bat-face early and spoons a leading edge in front of the seamer
good length and just a shade outside off, Williamson plays so very late, steering the ball through point
back of a length and spins into middle, Abhishek stands tall and punches through the vacant spaces at midwicket. They take on Hetmyer's arm and secure a hard-run double
another slower legbreak from Mishra, Williamson whisks it down to long-on
shorter legbreak, Williamson takes it from outside off and hauls a pull to the left of Rabada at deep midwicket. Williamson rushes back to the second
pitches outside leg and spins to hit the pad and pop up into the leg side. The lbw appeal is shot down. They cross over for a leg bye

Jadhav steps out at Mishra. The legspinner slows it up, shortens his length and gets it to break away outside off. Pant collects the ball and takes the bails off. SRH continue to slide around Williamson
short and spins away wide of off, chopped more or less straight to point
pumped over mid-off. Length ball on middle, Williamson shuffles outside leg, manufactures swinging room and chips it smartly over the infielder
on-pace bouncer on middle, Williamson ducks under it
slower ball outside off, dips under the bat as Williamson swings and misses outside off
Williamson rides the bounce of this short one outside off and expertly places it to the right of Mishra at deep third man
slower ball on middle and leg, Jadhav elects to sit back and work it to long leg
Williamson jumps on top of a short ball outside off and glides it behind point
flat and sliding into middle, tip and run into the off side again
swept from just a shade outside off to deep midwicket
slower and spins away outside off, late-cut to short third man
shortish and outside off, chopped straight to point
tip and run to cover-point. Good running from Jadhav and Williamson
good length and swerving into the pads, Jadhav diverts it away fine of Mishra at short fine leg for four
back of a length and skidding in at middle, Jadhav sits back and ekes out an inner edge to the leg side
Jadhav backs away outside leg, Avesh follows him with a lifter. Jadhav eventually ducks out of the way
short and sliding into off, Williamson hops and drops it wide of midwicket
very full on middle and leg, Jadhav hangs back and flicks it down to fine leg
short and wide of off, chopped straight to point

Virat can't clear Stoinis at midwicket. Back of a length and angling away from outside off, from over the wicket. Virat can't get on top of the bounce. He miscues a pull to the infielder. He falls for an utterly sluggish 4 off 12 balls
back of a length and homes away outside off past the outside edge
full and sliding in at off, poked to cover
chopped from an off-stump line to point for an urgent single
threatens to come in, but spins and bounces sharply outside off. Williamson does well to tuck his bat inside the line and ignore it
Williamson gets forward and delightfully chips it inside-out to the left of wide long-off
shorter and ducking in at off, stabbed back to the bowler off the inside half

sharp turn and sharper bounce for Ashwin. Pant rides it and takes the bails off. Biting offbreak from Ashwin. Virat stretches out for a booming cover-drive, loses his balance. Looks like his back foot is on the line when Pant takes the bails off. Okay, the split-screen shows that there's a tiny part of the foot behind the line by the time the bail is disturbed
short on the hips, whipped through the leg side off the back foot
Top batting from Williamson. Flat on middle and leg from around the wicket, be brings out another reverse. Eases it to the right of Mishra at point
floated on middle and off, driven off the front foot to long-off again
straightens along a middle-stump line from around the stumps, Williamson tucks through square leg off the back foot
pushed through outside off, this non-turner is driven through the line to wide long-off
Mishra slows it up further. Googly, veers it from outside off and kicks up at Williamson. Diffused to point
Mishra slows it up and gets it to break away outside off, glided to point
Mishra tosses a legbreak up outside off, shifts his line wider. Williamson unfurls a reverse-dab and gets it over slip
swept flat and hard to the right of deep midwicket. Pushed through just a shade outside off, non-turner, hauled away by Williamson
fuller and shaping in, wrong'un? Blocked into the leg side
flighted just a shade outside off, Williamson lunges and slices to point
Virat makes some room, Ashwin follows him, cramps him for room and closes out the over with a dot
forced down to long-on
shorter on middle, leans back and punches up to point
drifts in towards off stump and spins away sharply. A crease-bound Virat plays and misses in the channel
slider from around the wicket at 90ks, catches the batter in the tangle and hits the pad. This is heading past leg stump
looped up outside off, Virat stretches out to meet the pitch. Driven solidly to wide long-off
quickish slider from Mishra, pushed through the cover-point region
deftly paddled from just a shade outside off towards fine leg
back of a length and fizzing into middle, punched to the left of short midwicket

biting legbreak from Mishra to follow the wrong'un. Dangled up outside off, the flight lures Williamson forward. The dip creates distance between the bat and pitch. The turn takes it past the outside edge. Williamson just drags his back foot before Pant flips the bails off
starts off with a googly that brushes the thigh pad and rolls down leg past Pant
back of a length on middle, Virat hops and fends it back
Avesh pounds it on a hard length and gets it to zip past the outside edge after squaring up the batter

Bairstow aims for another six, but holes out to Dhawan. Bairstow shuffles across off once again, this is a seam-up length ball closer to off. Bairstow doesn't have enough room to free his hands. He still dares to hit over the top, but picks out Dhawan at mid-on
slot ball, overpitched and outside off, Bairstow backs away outside leg and makes it look a whole lot worse. Shanked over wide long-on for another six
back of a length and keeps low outside off, Williamson gets low with it, stabs it wide of Rabada at cover-point and sets off. A direct hit from Rabada could've got Williamson
Kane: Cool as. Banged in short and outside off, Kane leaps to get on top of it, opens the face and punches it handsomely between point and cover-point
slower through the air and dips at off, Bairstow goes for the slog-sweep, loses his shape, and ends up inside-edging it to short fine leg
Bairstow backs away outside leg again, this time he wallops it over wide long-on. Axar slides another one into his body and cops more punishment
Bairstow moves away outside leg and deliberately carves Axar over point. He manufactures swinging room, takes it from middle stump, and slices it in the air
speared into middle, clipped to midwicket off the back foot. A fumble allows a single
good length and drifting into off, defended from the crease
arm ball slides on outside off to beat Williamson's back-foot cut. Too close to the body and not all that short for the cut
a bit too full for the sweep, Ashwin pings the pad, but this is heading down leg
on a length, worked with the spin to square leg
fuller and flatter on middle, played back
Pant misses a stumping chance. Drift and turn for Ashwin, he has Williamson falling over again. The keeper loses his balance too as the ball pops out of his glove
tossed up around middle and spinning down the leg side, Ashwin has Williamson falling over, but he manages to tickle it fine of short fine leg for four

Has Warner been run-out? Yep, he has a wry smile on his face and walks off even before the TV umpire rules it out. Bairstow jabs it to the left of cover-point and they push across for a very risky single. Rabada swoops down on the ball, flings it to Pant, and catches the SRH captain short
smites it over long-on for six. Ashwin gets closer to the stumps and flicks out what looks like the carrom ball, muscled off the back foot
off-stump yorker, which is squeezed away to the right of mid-on
lifter just outside off, Bairstow sways his upper body out of the way and lets it through to the keeper
shovelled over mid-on. Struck flat and hard for six. Offcutter outside off, on a length, the batter punishes Stoinis once again
clouted over midwicket. One-bounce four. Length ball, angling in towards off stump, Bairstow sizes it up and gives it a good whack
back of a length on middle and leg, no room for Warner to free his hands, forced to deep square off the back foot
hard-length cutter just outside off, which is stabbed to midwicket off the back foot
rocks back and thumps the shortish delivery on middle to mid-off

dropped by Hetmyer on the midwicket boundary. The pull shot takes the ball high. Very very high. Hetmyer needs to track back, but he is nervous about where the rope is. He leaps up and back to try and catch it, but his error in judgment costs the wicket, and also yields four runs to Bairstow
steps away from his stumps and drills a flatter delivery in line with the stumps to point

caught behind! The on-field umpire Gaffaney has given it but Bairstow has reviewed his call. Another non-turning delivery. Bairstow plays for the turn. He drives on the up, and inside the line of the ball, but ultra-edge says there is no edge
skidder on off stump, Warner backs away and cuts into the covers
nudges a non-turning offbreak on his pads to short midwicket
punches a back of a length delivery to cover
slower delivery cramping Warner for room. He still manages to cut it to cover for a single.
works a rising delivery on middle and off stump away to deep square leg
pins him to the crease with a 143kph delivery, pitching up and desperate to crash into those stumps. Warner just about manages to prevent that with another inside edge
gets an inside edge to a good length ball nibbling into him on leg stump. Two behind square leg
shoulders arms to a rising delivery that thuds into Pant's gloves. Serious pace from Rabada.
